wire.console.title: Console capacity
wire.console.description: Live terminal admission. Completed history does not consume process slots. Changes affect future starts, never terminate running work.
wire.console.max_live.label: Live terminal ceiling
wire.console.max_live.help: 32–256; default 128. Managed memory, terminal cells and available native resources can admit fewer terminals. This does not limit child-process memory.
wire.console.max_owner.label: Agent terminals per conversation
wire.console.max_owner.help: 1–32; default 8. Each conversation shares the global live allowance; completed terminals do not count.
wire.console.user_reserved.label: Slots reserved for user terminals
wire.console.user_reserved.help: 4–32; default 16, capped at one quarter of the live ceiling. Agent starts cannot consume these slots. Existing work is never stopped.
